verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਿਰਮ ਚਖਾਇਆ ਭੁਖ ਨ ਖਾਣੁ ਪੀਅਣੁ ਅੰਨੁ ਪਾਣੀ।
verses.translit_en: gurmukh piram chakhaiaa bhukh na khaan peean a(n)n paanee|

en.bdb: The gurmukh having tasted the joy of love feels no desire for food and ink.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਨੀਂਦ ਉਘੜੀ ਜਾਗਦਿਆਂ ਸੁਖ ਰੈਣਿ ਵਿਹਾਣੀ।
verses.translit_en: sabadh surat nee(n)dh ughaRee jaagadhiaa(n) sukh rain vihaanee|

en.bdb: Due to the merger of his consciousness in the Word, he gets no eep and by getting awake, he spends his night delightfully.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਾਹੇ ਬਧੇ ਸੋਹਦੇ ਮੈਲਾਪੜ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ਪਰਾਣੀ।
verses.translit_en: saahe badhe sohadhe mailaapaR paravaan paraanee|

en.bdb: As for a few ays before marriage, the bride and the bridegroom look beautiful even in gs, the gurmukhs also remain adorned.

verses.gurmukhi: ਚਲਣੁ ਜਾਣਿ ਸੁਜਾਣ ਹੋਇ ਜਗ ਮਿਹਮਾਨ ਆਏ ਮਿਹਮਾਣੀ।
verses.translit_en: chalan jaan sujaan hoi jag mihamaan aae mihamaanee|

en.bdb: Since they understand the mystery f going from the world, they live like guests in the world (who must sooner r later go).

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਵਣਜਿ ਖੇਪ ਲੈ ਚਲੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਗਾਡੀ ਰਾਹੁ ਨੀਸਾਣੀ।
verses.translit_en: sach vanaj khep lai chale gurmukh gaaddee raahu neesaanee|

en.bdb: Being familiar with the highway of the wisdom of the Guru, Gurmukhs move on it with full load of the truthful merchandise.

verses.gurmukhi: ਹਲਤਿ ਪਲਤਿ ਮੁਖ ਉਜਲੇ ਗੁਰ ਸਿਖ ਗੁਰਸਿਖਾਂ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਣੀ।
verses.translit_en: halat palat mukh ujale gur sikh gursikhaa(n) man bhaanee|

en.bdb: The Sikhs ove the teachings of the Guru and their faces remain bright in this and in the world hereafter.
Always in the holy congregation, the ineffable story of the grandeur of) the Lord is told.
